title: GO100 중앙 승인 릴리스 계약
change_summary: 승인 후보를 보존하고 파괴적 시험 SQL 제거 및 실DB 검증 기준을 명시

snapshot_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the original approval snapshot FIELDS, not the transmitted contract subset.

x-migration.backward_compatibility: Additive table, index and trigger only; existing tables and non-GO100 approval behavior unchanged. Apply only after separate production DDL approval.
x-migration.rollback: Set AADS_GO100_DEPLOY_APPROVAL_ENABLED=false in both API and validator environments; stop new GO100 consumption and use existing cancel control for queued runs. Retain snapshots, indexes, trigger and audit rows. Do not DROP or mutate snapshots.
x-migration.trust_policy: Approval principal user_id must match the source session owner and run requested_by. Admin tenant is ignored; job/session tenant must match. Unbound legacy requests are blocked.
x-migration.host_gate: Run unit and isolated PostgreSQL integration tests with rc0 and skip0 before accepting candidate.

objects.trigger: go100_deploy_approval_immutable (BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE, FOR EACH STATEMENT)

x-migration.failure_rollback: Migration is transactional: failure rolls back all newly created objects. After application, disable the feature and retain the table and snapshots.
x-migration.validation_reason_policy: Compare run fields with the approved snapshot first (run_<field>_mismatch), then verify source provenance (source_sha_mismatch for source job SHA drift).
